description: Claude skills for UX and product design workflows

skills.name: vois-patterns
skills.author: Personify Labs
skills.description: Structural decision trees for container types, form states, table layouts, and page-level patterns. Use before vois-tokens. Routes to righter skill for all microcopy (labels, errors, buttons, helpers). Works standalone — telemetry tool calls are optional. Use when building pages, forms, features, workflows.

skills.name: vois-components
skills.author: Personify Labs
skills.description: Component selection rubrics organized by job-to-be-done. Use after vois-patterns determines structure, before vois-tokens applies tokens. Optionally records each choice via the vois_record_component_choice MCP tool if one is available.

skills.name: vois-tokens
skills.author: Personify Labs
skills.description: Rules and patterns for building UI with shadcn/ui, Tailwind v4 or StyleX, and Motion against a Vois design token set. Use when building components, pages, or any UI that should conform to the workspace design system. Tunes within guardrails using taste dials, flags DS-SLOP-* anti-tells (AI-gradient heroes, three-card grids, eyebrow overuse, etc.), and enforces the redesign no-silent-changes contract. Works standalone — no orchestrator required.

skills.name: righter
skills.author: Personify Labs
skills.description: Apply UX content writing principles to review existing UI copy or write new UI copy from scratch. Use this skill whenever someone asks you to review, audit, critique, or improve UI text, error messages, button labels, tooltips, empty states, onboarding copy, or any software interface copy.

skills.name: longform
skills.author: Personify Labs
skills.description: Write or review long-form thought-leadership content: Medium/blog posts, LinkedIn essays, newsletter pieces, and the narrative sections of a deck or GTM page. Uses a persona and voice blended from Nancy Duarte's storytelling structure and Wes Kao's operator-voice frameworks.

skills.name: design-ask
skills.author: Personify Labs
skills.description: Unpacks poorly written Jira or Azure DevOps tickets into design-relevant framing. Identifies what design work is actually being asked for, flags when tickets prescribe a UI solution instead of describing a user need.

skills.name: design-rationale
skills.author: Personify Labs
skills.description: Help designers articulate the cognitive science, behavioral psychology, and platform standards behind their design decisions. Use this skill when a designer needs to explain why they made a decision in a critique or design review.

skills.name: changelog-writer
skills.author: Personify Labs
skills.description: Writes external-facing changelog and release note entries in a pithy, tastefully sassy, occasionally clever voice that makes software updates fun to read without burying what actually shipped. For external/end-user changelogs only — ships with scripts that check structure, sass budget, voice, length, and cadence on every draft.

skills.name: metrics-tagging
skills.author: Personify Labs
skills.description: Analyze UI mockups, screenshots, or prototype frames to identify all trackable interactions and generate a complete analytics event taxonomy table. Use this skill whenever a designer wants to know what should be tagged, what events to fire, or how to document analytics for handoff.

skills.name: designer-ic-assessment
skills.author: Personify Labs
skills.description: Facilitates a structured behavioral assessment interview for IC designer levels, incorporating AI fluency across competency areas. Produces a competency-by-competency narrative, scores table, and CSV export for Notion/FigJam handoff.

skills.name: gtm-positioning
skills.author: Personify Labs
skills.description: Framework for B2B product positioning, GTM strategy selection, and website messaging. Covers three positioning strategies, five GTM types, page-by-page website messaging guide, and persona-based messaging matrix. Based on the Fletch framework by Anthony Pierri.

skills.name: survey-architect
skills.author: Personify Labs
skills.description: Turns a research question into a validated, deploy-ready survey. Runs a short intake to establish product context and learning goal, selects the right instrument (SEQ, SUS, UMUX-Lite, SUPR-Q, NPS, CSAT, CES, PSSUQ, or a custom item set), and outputs a platform-native file ready for Qualtrics, Typeform, or an in-app survey component. Entry point 1 of the research loop (see research-loop).

skills.name: feedback-synthesizer
skills.author: Personify Labs
skills.description: Turns raw survey results (scores + open-text comments) into a scored, statistically-tested, thematically-coded synthesis, and connects the two. Computes instrument-correct scores, confidence intervals, and significance testing; codes qualitative themes by judgment (not keyword matching); owns severity/priority scoring. Works standalone on any pile of feedback. Entry point 2 of the research loop (see research-loop).

skills.name: research-reporter
skills.author: Personify Labs
skills.description: Turns a feedback-synthesizer output into a stakeholder-ready report — exec summary, methodology, benchmark comparison, prioritized recommendations — formatted for the audience reading it (internal markdown/Notion vs. formal docx). Never re-derives scores, themes, or severity. Entry point 3 of the research loop (see research-loop).

skills.name: research-loop
skills.author: Personify Labs
skills.description: Orchestrates survey-architect, feedback-synthesizer, and research-reporter as an iterative research loop with kickback, not a one-way pipeline. Detects entry point, maintains the per-study file structure and per-product longitudinal benchmark, and caps loop-backs at 2 before surfacing to the researcher. Single entry point for any UX research task.
